description: This Java source file defines the class WriteOffLoanCommandHandler which handles write-off commands for loans within the Fineract platform. It is responsible for processing write-off commands and delegating the operation to the LoanWritePlatformService.

classes.name: WriteOffLoanCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles write-off commands for loans, processes incoming commands, and delegates the operation to the loan write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the write-off command for a loan, invoking the writeOff method on the LoanWritePlatformService.
